title: Appendix
html:
Who this group is for: each page has its own readers, see the "Readers" column below. The deployment guide is for the event organiser (the facilitator, the event owner, or the customer's cloud platform administrator); participants do not need it: they have no AWS access at all and only open the console address the organiser hands out, in a browser. The production integration page is for whoever connects an agent to business systems after the event. The glossary is for every participant, to look things up during the lab.

Chapter Contents Readers
Organizer deployment guide Before the event, deploy the environment in every team's AWS account, check the models and the release policy, and hand out access; troubleshoot during the event; tear down afterwards The organiser, working in the AWS console / CloudShell
Production integration: how business systems call an agent on AgentCore Call-path, security and architecture comparison of four ways to call an agent (Launchpad /v1, business backend + IAM, browser + JWT, business backend + JWT), the production recommendation, sample code and a go-live checklist The customer's architects and developers; reference material, not a hands-on lab
Glossary Criteria, golden set, gate and other terms: what each is, what it affects, which chapter and section uses it later and who does it; a quick index by phase Every participant, any time during the lab

The whole workshop runs in us-east-1 only, and every team needs its own AWS account.
